source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 已知在题图1-3所示电压、电流参考方向下，元件A的电压、电流分别为u=-3 V、i=5 A，元件B的电压、电流分别为u=5 V、i=-2 mA，试求两元件吸收的功率。
statement.en: Under the voltage and current reference directions shown in Fig. 1-3, element A has u = -3 V and i = 5 A, while element B has u = 5 V and i = -2 mA. Find the power absorbed by each element.

alt.zh: A：电流参考方向由左向右，电压左正右负；B：电流参考方向由右向左，电压右正左负。两者电流箭头都流入电压正参考端。
alt.en: A: current points left to right, with voltage positive on the left. B: current points right to left, with voltage positive on the right. Both current references enter the positive voltage-reference terminal.

prerequisites.zh: 电压和电流参考方向；关联参考方向；功率符号与单位换算。
prerequisites.en: Voltage and current reference directions; passive sign convention; power signs and unit conversion.

recognition.zh: 先看箭头是否流入标“+”的端子，再把带符号的数值代入公式。
recognition.en: First check whether the current arrow enters the terminal marked +, then substitute the signed values.

text.zh: A和B的电流参考方向都流入电压正参考端，因此两者吸收功率公式均为p=ui。
text.en: For both A and B, the current reference enters the positive voltage-reference terminal, so absorbed power is p = ui.

text.zh: A的电压为负，按给定参考方向直接代入。负吸收功率表示该元件实际提供功率。
text.en: Substitute the signed voltage for A. A negative absorbed power means that the element delivers power.

text.zh: 把-2 mA换成-0.002 A。B的吸收功率为-0.010 W，即-10 mW。
text.en: Convert -2 mA to -0.002 A. B absorbs -0.010 W, or -10 mW.

answer.zh: A吸收-15 W（提供15 W）；B吸收-10 mW（提供10 mW）。
answer.en: A absorbs -15 W (delivers 15 W); B absorbs -10 mW (delivers 10 mW).

pitfalls.zh: 不要因i为负而翻转箭头后仍代入原负值，避免重复改符号。
pitfalls.en: Do not reverse the arrow for a negative current and then keep the original negative value; that would change the sign twice.

pitfalls.zh: mA与A相差1000倍。
pitfalls.en: mA and A differ by a factor of 1000.

methods.zh: 按关联参考方向独立计算，并与书第332页（PDF341页）1-5参考答案逐项一致。
methods.en: Independently calculated using the passive sign convention and matched item by item to answer 1-5 on printed p. 332 (PDF p. 341).

title.zh: 已知支路电流，结合KCL与KVL求未知电流
title.en: Use KCL and KVL with known branch currents

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 题图1-5所示电路为某电路的一部分，已知i₁=6 A，i₂=-2 A，求图中电流i。
statement.en: The circuit in Fig. 1-5 is part of a larger circuit. Given i₁ = 6 A and i₂ = -2 A, find the current i shown in the figure.

alt.zh: 三个左端口分别经3 Ω电阻接入上、中、下节点，i₁、i₂、i₃参考方向均向右。上、中节点间6 Ω，中、下节点间18 Ω，上、下节点间右支路12 Ω；待求i沿12 Ω向下。
alt.en: Three left ports connect through 3 Ω resistors to the upper, middle, and lower nodes; i₁, i₂, and i₃ all point right. There are 6 Ω between upper and middle nodes, 18 Ω between middle and lower nodes, and 12 Ω in the right branch from upper to lower, with unknown i pointing downward.

prerequisites.zh: KCL、KVL、电阻关联参考方向。
prerequisites.en: KCL, KVL, and the resistor passive sign convention.

recognition.zh: 已有两个注入电流，先用KCL把内部支路电流都写成i，再对两条上到下的路径列一次KVL；不用求三个左端口的电压。
recognition.en: With two injection currents already known, use KCL to express the internal branch currents in terms of i, then equate the voltage drops along the two upper-to-lower paths. The left-port voltages are unnecessary.

title.en: Apply KCL at the upper node

text.zh: 设6 Ω中的电流向下为i₆。流入的6 A分成i和i₆，所以i₆=6-i。
text.en: Let i₆ point downward through 6 Ω. The 6 A entering the upper node splits into i and i₆.

title.en: Apply KCL at the middle node

text.zh: 设18 Ω中的电流向下为i₁₈。i₂=-2 A已经包含参考方向的信息，因此i₁₈=i₆+i₂=4-i。
text.en: Let i₁₈ point downward through 18 Ω. The value i₂ = -2 A already includes its reference-direction sign, so i₁₈ = i₆ + i₂ = 4 - i.

title.zh: 同起点、同终点的电压相等
title.en: Equate voltage drops between the same nodes

text.zh: 上到下经12 Ω的电压降为12i；经6 Ω和18 Ω的总电压降为6(6-i)+18(4-i)。
text.en: The voltage drop from upper to lower is 12i through 12 Ω and 6(6-i) + 18(4-i) through the other path.

text.zh: 整理得36i=108，故i=3 A。正号表示实际方向与图中向下的箭头一致。
text.en: Rearranging gives 36i = 108, so i = 3 A. The positive result agrees with the downward arrow.

answer.zh: i=3 A，沿12 Ω电阻向下。
answer.en: i = 3 A, downward through the 12 Ω resistor.

pitfalls.zh: i₂=-2 A表示中间端口实际流出2 A，KCL中保留负号。
pitfalls.en: i₂ = -2 A means 2 A actually leaves the middle port; retain the negative sign in KCL.

pitfalls.zh: 三个3 Ω电阻的电流已给定或可由整体KCL确定，求i不需要先算它们的压降。
pitfalls.en: The port currents are given or follow from overall KCL; their 3 Ω voltage drops are unnecessary for finding i.

methods.zh: 第二种方法：以下节点为0 V独立列节点方程，得上节点36 V、中节点18 V，故i=36/12=3 A。内部电流i₆=3 A、i₁₈=1 A满足全部KCL；书第332页（PDF341页）答案亦为3 A。
methods.en: Independent nodal check with the lower node at 0 V gives upper 36 V and middle 18 V, hence i = 36/12 = 3 A. Internal currents i₆ = 3 A and i₁₈ = 1 A satisfy every KCL equation. The answer on printed p. 332 (PDF p. 341) is also 3 A.

title.zh: 先由电流求电阻压降，再求电流源端电压
title.en: Find current-source voltages from resistor drops

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电路如题图1-22所示，求两个电流源两端的电压U₁、U₂。
statement.en: For the circuit shown in Fig. 1-22, find the voltages U₁ and U₂ across the two current sources.

alt.zh: 左支路为3 A向下电流源，U₁上正下负。中支路为2 Ω电阻串联5 V电压源，电压源上正下负。上节点经过1 Ω接右支路2 A向下电流源，U₂上正下负，其下串联3 Ω回到底节点。
alt.en: Left branch: 3 A current source downward, U₁ positive at the top. Middle branch: 2 Ω resistor in series with a 5 V source positive at the top. The upper node connects through 1 Ω to a downward 2 A current source with U₂ positive at the top, followed by 3 Ω to the lower node.

prerequisites.zh: KCL、KVL、节点电位与电压参考极性。
prerequisites.en: KCL, KVL, node potentials, and voltage reference polarity.

recognition.zh: 电流源已经确定其支路电流。先对上下节点用KCL，再沿已知电压源的支路求节点电位，最后求两个电流源电压。
recognition.en: The current sources fix their branch currents. Use KCL at the common nodes, find node potentials through the branch containing the known voltage source, then compute the source voltages.

text.zh: 取底节点为0 V。3 A和2 A都向下流出顶节点，因此中支路向上电流为5 A，即按向下参考方向为-5 A。
text.en: Set the lower node to 0 V. The 3 A and 2 A branches both leave the upper node downward, so the middle branch carries 5 A upward, or -5 A under a downward reference.

text.zh: 5 V电压源上端电位为5 V；2 Ω电阻按自上而下的压降为2×(-5)=-10 V，所以顶节点电位为-5 V。U₁按上正下负，等于-5 V。
text.en: The upper terminal of the 5 V source is at 5 V. The downward voltage drop across 2 Ω is 2(-5) = -10 V, making the upper node -5 V. Since U₁ is referenced positive at the top, U₁ = -5 V.

text.zh: 右支路电流为2 A。1 Ω电阻压降2 V，故电流源上端电位为-7 V；3 Ω电阻上端电位为6 V。按U₂的上正下负参考极性相减。
text.en: The right branch carries 2 A. The 1 Ω resistor drops 2 V, so the source upper terminal is at -7 V. The upper terminal of 3 Ω is at 6 V. Subtract according to U₂’s top-positive polarity.

answer.zh: U₁=-5 V，U₂=-13 V；两者实际电压极性均与图示参考极性相反。
answer.en: U₁ = -5 V and U₂ = -13 V. Both actual voltage polarities oppose the indicated reference polarities.

pitfalls.zh: 电流源并不自动规定其端电压为正；电流箭头和电压极性是不同的参考信息。
pitfalls.en: A current source does not force its terminal voltage to be positive; the current arrow and voltage polarity are separate references.

pitfalls.zh: 题干在书第34页，图在第35页，必须同时查看。
pitfalls.en: The statement is on printed p. 34 and the figure on p. 35; both pages are required.

methods.zh: 右支路KVL：2+(-13)+6=-5 V，与U₁一致。三电阻耗散50+4+12=66 W；3 A源、2 A源和5 V源吸收功率分别为-15、-26、-25 W，合计-66 W，功率守恒。书第332页（PDF341页）给出相同的-5 V、-13 V。
methods.en: Right-branch KVL gives 2 + (-13) + 6 = -5 V, matching U₁. The resistors dissipate 50 + 4 + 12 = 66 W; the 3 A, 2 A, and 5 V sources absorb -15, -26, and -25 W, totaling -66 W. Power balances. Printed p. 332 (PDF p. 341) gives the same -5 V and -13 V.

title.zh: 受控电压源：把控制关系与KVL一起列出
title.en: Controlled voltage source: combine its law with KVL

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电路题图1-24所示，求在下列条件下受控源的电压：(1) uₛ=2 V；(2) uₛ=8 V。
statement.en: For the circuit in Fig. 1-24, find the controlled-source voltage for (1) uₛ = 2 V and (2) uₛ = 8 V.

alt.zh: 左侧独立电压源uₛ上正下负；上方2 Ω电阻电压u₁左正右负；右侧受控电压源3u₁上正下负，三者组成单回路。
alt.en: The independent voltage source uₛ on the left is positive at the top. The upper 2 Ω resistor has u₁ positive on the left. The right controlled voltage source is 3u₁, positive at the top. All three form one loop.

prerequisites.zh: KVL；电压控制电压源的控制关系。
prerequisites.en: KVL and the voltage-controlled voltage-source relation.

recognition.zh: 受控源的电压不是额外给定的常数。将3u₁作为同一未知量的倍数，整圈只剩一个电压未知量。
recognition.en: The controlled-source voltage is not an independent constant. Writing it as 3u₁ leaves only one unknown voltage in the loop.

text.zh: 从左下沿顺时针绕行：独立源提供电压上升uₛ，随后两段压降为u₁与3u₁。
text.en: Going clockwise from the lower left, the independent source gives a rise uₛ, followed by drops u₁ and 3u₁.

text.zh: 因此u₁=uₛ/4；题目要求的是受控源电压3u₁，而不是电阻电压u₁。
text.en: Thus u₁ = uₛ/4. The requested voltage is 3u₁ across the controlled source, not u₁ across the resistor.

text.zh: uₛ=2 V时，u₁=0.5 V，受控源电压1.5 V；uₛ=8 V时，u₁=2 V，受控源电压6 V。
text.en: For uₛ = 2 V, u₁ = 0.5 V and the controlled-source voltage is 1.5 V. For uₛ = 8 V, u₁ = 2 V and the controlled-source voltage is 6 V.

answer.zh: (1) 1.5 V；(2) 6 V，均按图示上正下负参考极性。
answer.en: (1) 1.5 V; (2) 6 V, with the indicated top-positive polarity.

pitfalls.zh: 不要把受控源当成独立源另设任意数值，也不要把u₁作为最终答案。
pitfalls.en: Do not treat the dependent source as an arbitrary independent value or report u₁ as the requested answer.

methods.zh: 分别回代KVL：0.5+1.5=2 V，2+6=8 V；同时满足受控关系u_d=3u₁。书第332页/PDF341页1-26给出相同的1.5 V、6 V。
methods.en: Substitution gives 0.5 + 1.5 = 2 V and 2 + 6 = 8 V, and both satisfy u_d = 3u₁. Answer 1-26 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341 gives the same 1.5 V and 6 V.

title.zh: 受控电流源功率：先电流，后端电压
title.en: Controlled current-source power: find current and voltage

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 题图1-28所示电路中各参数已给定，试求受控电流源的功率，并说明是吸收功率还是提供功率。
statement.en: All parameters of the circuit in Fig. 1-28 are given. Find the power of the controlled current source and state whether it absorbs or delivers power.

alt.zh: 底部为公共节点。左节点经1 Ω接底部；左、中节点间2 Ω，中、右节点间4 Ω，左、右节点间上支路3 Ω。中节点经上正下负的6 V电压源接底部，I₁参考向上。右节点向下先经过上负下正的12 V源，再经过大小I₁/3、方向向下的受控电流源到底部。
alt.en: The bottom is common. The left node connects to it through 1 Ω. There are 2 Ω between left and middle, 4 Ω between middle and right, and 3 Ω between left and right. A 6 V source, positive at the middle node, connects middle to bottom, with I₁ upward. From the right node downward, a 12 V source is negative at the top and positive at the bottom, followed by a downward controlled current source I₁/3.

prerequisites.zh: KCL、KVL、受控电流源；关联参考方向下的功率。
prerequisites.en: KCL, KVL, controlled current sources, and passive-sign power.

recognition.zh: 6 V源先给出中节点电位。受控源电流由I₁决定，端电压则须把右节点电位与12 V源极性一起计算，不能只用I₁/3求功率。
recognition.en: The 6 V source fixes the middle-node potential. The dependent-source current follows from I₁, but its voltage also depends on the right-node potential and 12 V source polarity.

title.en: Define node potentials and control current

text.zh: 取底节点为0 V，左、右节点分别为vL、vR，中节点为6 V。中节点KCL把I₁写成两个电阻电流之和。以下电压用V、电阻用Ω。
text.en: Set the bottom to 0 V, the left and right potentials to vL and vR, and the middle potential to 6 V. Middle-node KCL expresses I₁ as the sum of two resistor currents. Voltages are in V and resistances in Ω.

title.en: Apply KCL at the left and right nodes

text.zh: 左节点的三条电阻支路电流相加为0；右节点向下支路电流由受控源固定为I₁/3。
text.en: Sum the three resistor currents at the left node. At the right node, the downward branch current is fixed to I₁/3 by the controlled source.

text.zh: 将I₁代入右节点方程，化为(vR−vL)/2=0，故vR=vL。左节点方程随后给出vL=vR=2 V。于是I₁=2+1=3 A，受控源电流为1 A向下。
text.en: Substituting I₁ in the right-node equation reduces it to (vR−vL)/2 = 0. Hence vR = vL; the left-node equation gives both as 2 V. Then I₁ = 2 + 1 = 3 A and the controlled source carries 1 A downward.

steps.formula: v_L=v_R=2\,\mathrm V,\qquad I_1=3\,\mathrm A,\qquad I_d=1\,\mathrm A

title.zh: 根据12 V源极性求端电压和功率
title.en: Use the 12 V polarity to find voltage and power

text.zh: 12 V源下正上负，因此受控电流源上端电位为vR+12=14 V。自行取其端电压上正下负，与向下电流构成关联方向，故吸收功率为正。
text.en: The 12 V source is positive at its lower terminal, placing the controlled-source upper terminal at vR + 12 = 14 V. Referencing its voltage positive at the top is passive with the downward current, so its absorbed power is positive.

answer.zh: 受控电流源吸收14 W。
answer.en: The controlled current source absorbs 14 W.

pitfalls.zh: 12 V源的上端标“−”、下端标“+”，不能把受控源上端电位误写成vR−12。
pitfalls.en: The 12 V source is negative at its upper terminal and positive at its lower terminal; the controlled-source upper potential is vR + 12.

pitfalls.zh: 受控源是电源模型，但仍可能吸收功率；必须依据端电压与电流的共同参考方向判断。
pitfalls.en: A controlled source can absorb power. Determine the sign from both its voltage and current references.

methods.zh: 独立功率平衡：1、2、4 Ω电阻分别耗散4、8、4 W，3 Ω电流为0；6 V源吸收−18 W，12 V源吸收−12 W，受控源吸收14 W，总和16−18−12+14=0。书第332页/PDF341页1-30也给出14 W、吸收功率。
methods.en: Independent power balance: the 1, 2 and 4 Ω resistors dissipate 4, 8 and 4 W; the 3 Ω current is zero. The 6 V and 12 V sources absorb −18 and −12 W, and the controlled source absorbs 14 W: 16−18−12+14 = 0. Answer 1-30 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341 is also 14 W absorbed.

title.zh: 交叉线不相连：开关前后的等效电阻
title.en: Unconnected crossing wires: resistance before and after switching

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图1-30所示单口网络分别在开关S打开和闭合时的等效电阻。
statement.en: Find the equivalent resistance of the one-port network in Fig. 1-30 with switch S open and with S closed.

alt.zh: a在左上，b在左下，右上与右下两节点由开关S连接。a到右上为36 Ω，a到右下斜支路也为36 Ω；b到右下为24 Ω，b到右上斜支路也为24 Ω。两条斜线在中央交叉处无连接点，互不连接。
alt.en: Terminal a is upper left and b lower left. Switch S connects the upper-right and lower-right nodes. There are 36 Ω from a to each right node and 24 Ω from b to each right node. The crossing diagonal wires have no junction and are not connected.

prerequisites.zh: 按节点判断串并联；无连接点的交叉线。
prerequisites.en: Series/parallel reduction by nodes and unconnected wire crossings.

recognition.zh: 先按导线连接关系重画，不能把中央交叉当节点。开关打开时是两条独立串联支路，闭合时是两组并联电阻串联。
recognition.en: Redraw by connectivity, keeping the central crossing disconnected. With S open there are two series paths in parallel; with S closed, two parallel groups are in series.

text.zh: a经任一右侧节点到b都必须依次经过36 Ω和24 Ω，每条路径60 Ω；两条路径只在a、b端相接。
text.en: Each a-to-b path through a right node contains 36 Ω and 24 Ω in series, making 60 Ω. The two paths meet only at a and b.

text.zh: 两个右侧节点被短接合并。a到该公共节点有两个36 Ω并联，b到该节点有两个24 Ω并联，再将两组串联。
text.en: The two right nodes merge. The two 36 Ω resistors from a are parallel, as are the two 24 Ω resistors from b. These groups are then in series.

text.zh: 原来两条路径具有相同分压比例，所以右侧两个节点本来等电位。连接等电位节点不会改变端口电流。
text.en: The two original paths have identical divider ratios, so the right nodes are already at equal potentials. Connecting them does not change terminal current.

answer.zh: S打开：30 Ω；S闭合：30 Ω。
answer.en: S open: 30 Ω. S closed: 30 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: 中央导线交叉无黑点，不可自行增加连接。开关闭合也不等于把整个端口短路。
pitfalls.en: Do not add a connection at the unmarked central crossing. Closing S does not short the entire port.

methods.zh: 独立1 V测试：令Va=1 V、Vb=0，开关打开时两个右侧节点均为24/(36+24)=0.4 V；总测试电流为2×(1−0.4)/36=1/30 A，故Req=30 Ω。等电位使闭合时开关电流为0，结果仍30 Ω。书第332页/PDF341页1-32为30 Ω、30 Ω。
methods.en: Independent 1 V test: with Va = 1 V and Vb = 0, both right nodes are at 24/(36+24) = 0.4 V. Total test current is 2(1−0.4)/36 = 1/30 A, giving 30 Ω. The closed switch carries zero current between equal potentials, preserving 30 Ω. Answer 1-32 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341 gives 30 Ω in both cases.

title.zh: 电源等效变换：先合并为诺顿源
title.en: Source transformation: combine Norton sources first

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 利用电源等效变换求题图1-43所示电路中的电流i。
statement.en: Use source equivalence transformations to find the current i in Fig. 1-43.

alt.zh: 三个支路并联于上、下公共节点。左支路为1 Ω电阻串联9 V电压源（上正下负）；中支路为2 Ω串联4 V电压源（上负下正）；右支路7 Ω，i向下。
alt.en: Three branches share upper and lower nodes. The left has 1 Ω in series with a 9 V source positive at the top. The middle has 2 Ω in series with a 4 V source positive at the bottom. The right has 7 Ω with i downward.

prerequisites.zh: 电压源与串联电阻的诺顿等效；电流源并联；分流公式。
prerequisites.en: Norton transformation of a voltage source and series resistor; parallel sources; current division.

recognition.zh: 两电压源的正端相反，变换后电流源方向也相反。先作带符号的电流源合并，再对7 Ω负载分流。
recognition.en: The sources have opposite polarities, so their transformed current sources oppose. Combine their signed currents before finding the 7 Ω branch current.

text.zh: 9 V串联1 Ω等效为9 A向上电流源并联1 Ω，使上节点开路电位为正。
text.en: The 9 V source with 1 Ω becomes a 9 A upward current source in parallel with 1 Ω, preserving a positive open-circuit upper potential.

title.en: Transform and combine the middle branch

text.zh: 4 V源正端在底部，等效电流源为2 A向下。两源净电流为7 A向上，内阻为1 Ω与2 Ω并联。
text.en: The 4 V source is positive at the bottom, so its Norton current is 2 A downward. The net current is 7 A upward, with 1 Ω and 2 Ω in parallel.

text.zh: 7 A在内阻2/3 Ω和负载7 Ω之间分流。i沿7 Ω向下，为正。
text.en: The 7 A divides between 2/3 Ω and the 7 Ω load. Current i is positive downward through the load.

answer.en: i = 14/23 A ≈ 0.609 A, downward.

pitfalls.zh: 中支路4 V源的正端在下方，不能把两个诺顿电流源都取向上。
pitfalls.en: The 4 V source is positive at the lower terminal; its Norton source must oppose the 9 A source.

pitfalls.zh: 源等效保持端口特性，不保证变换前后内部元件的功率逐项相同。
pitfalls.en: Source equivalence preserves port behavior, not every internal element power.

methods.zh: 直接对原电路独立列KCL：(V−9)/1+(V+4)/2+V/7=0，得V=98/23 V，i=V/7=14/23 A。书第333页/PDF342页1-45列0.61 A，与精确值四舍五入一致。
methods.en: Independent original-circuit KCL gives (V−9)/1 + (V+4)/2 + V/7 = 0, so V = 98/23 V and i = V/7 = 14/23 A. Answer 1-45 on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342 gives 0.61 A, matching the rounded exact value.

title.zh: 一棵树确定全部基本割集与基本回路
title.en: One spanning tree determines all fundamental cutsets and loops

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 在题图2-1(b)中选树T(3,4,5,6)，分别找出对应的基本割集和基本回路。
statement.en: In Fig. 2-1(b), choose the spanning tree T = (3, 4, 5, 6). Find the corresponding fundamental cutsets and fundamental loops.

alt.zh: 为说明拓扑，临时将左、中、右上、左下、右下节点依次命名A、B、C、D、E。有向支路为1:A→D，2:A→B，3:C→A，4:D→B，5:B→C，6:B→E，7:E→C，8:E→D。图中的G为图名。
alt.en: For description, label the left, center, upper-right, lower-left and lower-right nodes A, B, C, D and E. Directed edges are 1: A→D, 2: A→B, 3: C→A, 4: D→B, 5: B→C, 6: B→E, 7: E→C and 8: E→D. G in the source figure denotes the graph.

prerequisites.zh: 树、树支、连支、基本割集与基本回路定义。
prerequisites.en: Spanning trees, twigs, links, fundamental cutsets and fundamental loops.

recognition.zh: 基本割集逐根删除树支求；基本回路逐根加入连支求。每组必须恰含一个对应树支或连支，不能枚举任意割集、任意回路。
recognition.en: Find each fundamental cutset by deleting one twig, and each fundamental loop by adding one link. Use the specified tree rather than enumerating arbitrary cuts or loops.

text.zh: 全图5个节点、8条支路。给定4条树支3、4、5、6连通全图且不成环；剩余连支为1、2、7、8。
text.en: The graph has 5 nodes and 8 edges. Twigs 3, 4, 5 and 6 connect all nodes without a cycle. Links are 1, 2, 7 and 8.

title.en: Delete each twig for its fundamental cutset

text.zh: 删3后A与其余节点分开，跨分区边为1、2、3；删4后D孤立，跨边为1、4、8；删5后{A,C}与{B,D,E}分开，跨边为1、2、5、7；删6后E孤立，跨边为6、7、8。
text.en: Deleting 3 isolates A, giving edges 1,2,3. Deleting 4 isolates D, giving 1,4,8. Deleting 5 separates {A,C} from {B,D,E}, giving 1,2,5,7. Deleting 6 isolates E, giving 6,7,8.

title.en: Add each link for its fundamental loop

text.zh: 加入连支1，沿树中D→B→C→A闭合，得到{1,3,4,5}；加入2得到{2,3,5}；加入7得到{5,6,7}；加入8得到{4,6,8}。集合内部顺序不影响答案。
text.en: Adding link 1 closes through the tree path D→B→C→A, giving {1,3,4,5}. Adding links 2, 7 and 8 gives {2,3,5}, {5,6,7} and {4,6,8}. Set ordering does not matter.

pitfalls.zh: 基本割集恰含一条树支，其余为连支；基本回路恰含一条连支，其余为树支。
pitfalls.en: A fundamental cutset contains exactly one twig; a fundamental loop contains exactly one link.

pitfalls.zh: 题目只问支路集合；若进一步列KCL/KVL，应另按选定割集或回路方向处理正负号。
pitfalls.en: This question asks for edge sets. Signed KCL/KVL equations additionally require cutset or loop orientations.

methods.zh: 用保存的有向边表独立进行删边连通分量与树路径检查：4个割集均恰含相应一个树支，4个回路均恰含相应一个连支，数量符合n−1=4和b−n+1=4。书第333页/PDF342页2-3的所有集合相同（书中回路元素顺序略有不同）。
methods.en: An independent edge-table check of components after twig deletion and paths in the tree confirms every cutset and loop; each has exactly its one designated twig or link. Counts match n−1 = 4 and b−n+1 = 4. All sets match answer 2-3 on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342, regardless of listed element order.

title.zh: 节点法：先列注入电流，再求端口电压差
title.en: Nodal analysis: injections first, port difference last

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 试用节点电压法求题图2-9所示电路中的电压u。
statement.en: Use nodal-voltage analysis to find voltage u in Fig. 2-9.

alt.zh: 底左公共节点接地，15 V源上正下负，其上端经3 Ω接节点1。节点1经6 Ω接地，经2 Ω接节点2；另有5 A源从节点1指向节点2。节点2经2 Ω接节点3，节点3经2 Ω接地。输出u按节点2正、节点3负。
alt.en: The lower-left common node is ground. A 15 V source positive at the top connects through 3 Ω to node 1. Node 1 connects to ground through 6 Ω and to node 2 through 2 Ω, with a 5 A source also pointing from 1 to 2. Node 2 connects through 2 Ω to node 3, which connects through 2 Ω to ground. Output u is positive at node 2 and negative at node 3.

prerequisites.zh: 节点电压法；电流源的注入符号；电压等于节点电位差。
prerequisites.en: Nodal analysis, current-source injection signs and voltage as a node-potential difference.

recognition.zh: 5 A在节点1流出、节点2流入，两条方程右端符号相反。输出端负极是节点3，不能直接把节点2电位当输出。
recognition.en: The 5 A source leaves node 1 and enters node 2, so its injection signs oppose. The output negative terminal is node 3, not ground.

text.zh: 取节点电压为v₁、v₂、v₃，源上端已知15 V。节点1电阻流出电流之和等于−5 A。
text.en: Let node potentials be v₁, v₂ and v₃. The source upper terminal is at 15 V. Resistor currents leaving node 1 sum to −5 A.

text.zh: 节点2注入5 A，节点3没有外部注入。
text.en: Node 2 receives 5 A; node 3 has no external injection.

text.zh: 第一式化为v₂=2v₁，第三式给v₂=2v₃；代入第二式，得到v₁=v₃=5 V、v₂=10 V。
text.en: The first equation gives v₂ = 2v₁ and the third gives v₂ = 2v₃. Substitution into the second gives v₁ = v₃ = 5 V and v₂ = 10 V.

steps.formula: v_1=5\,\mathrm V,\quad v_2=10\,\mathrm V,\quad v_3=5\,\mathrm V

title.zh: 按输出参考极性取电位差

text.zh: 输出u的正端是2，负端是3。
text.en: The positive output terminal is 2 and the negative terminal is 3.

answer.zh: u=5 V。
answer.en: u = 5 V.

pitfalls.zh: 同一个5 A源在两个节点的注入符号相反，不能两处都写+5。
pitfalls.en: The same 5 A source has opposite injection signs at nodes 1 and 2.

pitfalls.zh: 节点3不是地，u=v₂−v₃，而非v₂。
pitfalls.en: Node 3 is not ground: u = v₂−v₃, not v₂.

methods.zh: 独立源变换复核：节点1左侧15 V/3 Ω与6 Ω网络等效为10 V串联2 Ω；节点1到2的5 A∥2 Ω变为使节点2升高10 V的串联源。外回路总电阻2+2+4=8 Ω，电流(10+10)/8=2.5 A，故节点2为10 V、节点3为5 V，输出5 V。书第333页/PDF342页2-11亦为5 V。
methods.en: Independent source-transformation check: the left 15 V/3 Ω and 6 Ω network becomes 10 V in series with 2 Ω. The 5 A parallel 2 Ω between nodes 1 and 2 becomes a 10 V rise toward node 2 in series with 2 Ω. The loop current is (10+10)/(2+2+4) = 2.5 A, giving node 2 at 10 V and node 3 at 5 V, hence u = 5 V. Answer 2-11 on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342 agrees.

title.zh: 受控电压源：先读正负端，再写约束
title.en: Controlled voltage source: polarity before constraints

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图2-10所示电路中的电流i。
statement.en: Find current i in the circuit of Fig. 2-10.

alt.zh: 上下为公共节点。左支路4 Ω，i参考向上；第二支路为3 A向上源；第三支路为电压5i的受控电压源（上负下正）串联2 Ω；最右支路12 Ω。
alt.en: The upper and lower nodes are common. The left branch is 4 Ω with i upward. The next is a 3 A upward source. The third has a controlled voltage source 5i, negative at the top and positive at the bottom, in series with 2 Ω. The right branch is 12 Ω.

prerequisites.zh: 节点法；电流控制电压源；控制电流的参考方向。
prerequisites.en: Nodal analysis, current-controlled voltage sources and current reference direction.

recognition.zh: 全电路只有一个公共上节点电位，但受控源与2 Ω之间还要写一个电压约束。i向上，因此i=−v/4。
recognition.en: There is one common upper-node potential, with an additional constraint at the junction of the controlled source and 2 Ω. Since i points upward, i = −v/4.

title.zh: 定义节点并写控制关系
title.en: Define potentials and the control relation

text.zh: 底节点为0 V，上节点为v，受控源下端与2 Ω上端连接点为vx。左支路i向上；受控源正端在下方。
text.en: Set the bottom to 0 V, the upper potential to v and the source/resistor junction to vx. Current i is upward, and the controlled source is positive at its lower terminal.

title.en: Apply KCL at the upper node

text.zh: 三条非独立电流源支路的向下电流分别为v/4、vx/2和v/12，它们之和等于3 A向上注入。
text.en: The downward currents in the three other branches are v/4, vx/2 and v/12. Their sum equals the 3 A upward injection.
Substituting i = −v/4 gives vx = −v/4. KCL becomes 5v/24 = 3, so v = 14.4 V and i = −3.6 A.

answer.zh: i=−3.6 A，即4 Ω支路实际电流3.6 A向下。
answer.en: i = −3.6 A: the actual current through 4 Ω is 3.6 A downward.

pitfalls.zh: 原图受控源上负下正，必须写vx−v=5i，不能写v−vx=5i。
pitfalls.en: The source is negative at the top and positive below: write vx−v = 5i, not v−vx = 5i.

pitfalls.zh: 负的i同时影响受控源电压，不应在代入时去掉负号。
pitfalls.en: The signed current also controls the source voltage; do not discard its negative sign.

methods.zh: 独立支路与功率核验：vx=−3.6 V，中间支路向下电流−1.8 A；上节点向下电流3.6−1.8+1.2=3 A。电阻耗散51.84+6.48+17.28=75.6 W；3 A源吸收−43.2 W，受控源上到下电压18 V、向下电流−1.8 A，吸收−32.4 W，总和0。书第333页/PDF342页2-12为−3.6 A。
methods.en: Independent branch/power check: vx = −3.6 V and the middle downward current is −1.8 A. Downward currents sum to 3.6−1.8+1.2 = 3 A. Resistor powers total 51.84+6.48+17.28 = 75.6 W. The 3 A source absorbs −43.2 W; the controlled source has an 18 V top-to-bottom drop with −1.8 A downward, absorbing −32.4 W. Total power is zero. Answer 2-12 on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342 is −3.6 A.

title.zh: 网孔法遇电流源：超网孔加电流约束
title.en: A current source in mesh analysis: supermesh plus constraint

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 试用网孔分析法求题图2-18所示电路中的电流i₁、i₂和i₃。
statement.en: Use mesh analysis to find currents i₁, i₂ and i₃ in Fig. 2-18.

alt.zh: 底部公共节点，左2 V源上负下正，经上方4 Ω接顶中节点，4 Ω电流i₁向右；顶中经5 Ω接右30 V源上端，i₂向右，30 V源也上负下正。顶中与底部之间另有2 Ω电阻（i₃向下）和3 A向下电流源两条并联支路。
alt.en: The bottom is common. The left 2 V source is negative at the top and connects through upper 4 Ω to the middle-top node, with i₁ rightward. A 5 Ω resistor carries i₂ rightward from this node to the upper terminal of the right 30 V source, also negative at the top. A 2 Ω resistor with i₃ downward and a 3 A downward current source separately connect middle-top to bottom.

prerequisites.zh: 顺时针网孔电流；共享支路电流差；超网孔。
prerequisites.en: Clockwise mesh currents, differences in shared branches and supermeshes.

recognition.zh: 电流源位于两个相邻网孔的公共边，其端电压未知，不能写成电阻压降。把这两个网孔合成超网孔，再补电流源约束。
recognition.en: The current source lies between adjacent meshes and has an unknown voltage. Form a supermesh around those meshes and add the current constraint.

text.zh: 从左到右，三个最小网孔取顺时针电流j₁、j₂、j₃。则i₁=j₁，i₂=j₃，2 Ω中向下电流i₃=j₁−j₂。
text.en: Take clockwise mesh currents j₁, j₂ and j₃ from left to right. Then i₁ = j₁, i₂ = j₃ and the downward 2 Ω current is i₃ = j₁−j₂.

text.zh: 左2 V源从下向上经过是从正端到负端，为2 V压降。
text.en: Traversing the left 2 V source upward goes from positive to negative, producing a 2 V drop.

title.zh: 中右超网孔与电流约束

text.zh: 超网孔绕过3 A源，经过5 Ω、30 V源和2 Ω。右30 V源从上向下是电压上升。3 A向下等于中网孔向下减右网孔向上。
text.en: The supermesh bypasses the 3 A source and passes through 5 Ω, the 30 V source and 2 Ω. Traversing the 30 V source downward is a voltage rise. The downward 3 A equals the middle mesh current minus the right mesh current.

text.zh: 解得j₁=2 A、j₂=7 A、j₃=4 A。因此i₁=2 A、i₂=4 A、i₃=−5 A；i₃实际向上5 A。
text.en: Solving gives j₁ = 2 A, j₂ = 7 A and j₃ = 4 A. Thus i₁ = 2 A, i₂ = 4 A and i₃ = −5 A; its actual direction is 5 A upward.

steps.formula: i_1=2\,\mathrm A,\qquad i_2=4\,\mathrm A,\qquad i_3=-5\,\mathrm A

answer.zh: i₁=2 A，i₂=4 A，i₃=−5 A（按图示参考方向）。
answer.en: i₁ = 2 A, i₂ = 4 A and i₃ = −5 A, using the figure reference directions.

pitfalls.zh: i₃是共享支路电流差，不是某一个网孔电流。
pitfalls.en: i₃ is a difference of mesh currents, not a single mesh current.

pitfalls.zh: 两个电压源均上负下正，绕行时必须逐个判定电压升降。
pitfalls.en: Both voltage sources are negative at the top; determine each voltage rise or drop from the traversal direction.

methods.en: Independent nodal check: with bottom at 0 V, the left and right upper terminals are −2 V and −30 V. The middle-top V satisfies (V+2)/4 + V/2 + (V+30)/5 + 3 = 0, giving V = −10 V. Then i₁ = [−2−(−10)]/4 = 2 A, i₂ = [−10−(−30)]/5 = 4 A and i₃ = −10/2 = −5 A. KCL gives 2 = 4−5+3. Answer 2-20 on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342 matches all three.

title.zh: 含电压源的反馈电路：先定输入端电位
title.en: Feedback with voltage sources: find input-node voltages first

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 试分别求出图题2.3.2中各运放电路的V_O电压值。
statement.en: Find the output voltage V_O of each op-amp circuit in Fig. 2.3.2.

alt.zh: 四种负反馈电路。(a)同相端接地，反相端与10 kΩ、20 kΩ分压节点V₁之间串联2 V源（V₁为正端）；(b)同相端接+2 V，反相端接同一分压节点；(c)同相端接地，输出经20 kΩ和2 V源反馈到反相端，源上端为正；(d)同相端接+2 V，输出经20 kΩ反馈到反相端。
alt.en: Four negative-feedback circuits. (a) The non-inverting input is grounded; a 2 V source, positive at divider node V₁, connects V₁ to the inverting input; V₁ is between 10 kΩ to ground and 20 kΩ to the output. (b) The non-inverting input is at +2 V and the inverting input connects directly to the same divider. (c) The grounded non-inverting input is paired with feedback through 20 kΩ and a 2 V source positive at its upper terminal. (d) The non-inverting input is at +2 V and feedback uses 20 kΩ.

prerequisites.zh: 理想运放虚短和虚断；电压源极性；KCL。
prerequisites.en: Ideal op-amp virtual short and zero input currents; voltage-source polarity; KCL.

recognition.zh: 不要先套同相/反相放大器增益公式。先由同相端求反相端电位，再沿反馈路径用电压源极性和零输入电流求输出。
recognition.en: First infer the inverting-input potential from the non-inverting input. Then use source polarity and zero input current along the feedback path to find the output.

text.zh: 四图都为负反馈。理想线性运放满足V_N=V_P，且流入两个输入端的电流均为零。串在反馈中的独立电压源仍保留其规定电压。
text.en: All four circuits use negative feedback. In ideal linear operation, V_N = V_P and both input currents are zero. An independent voltage source in the feedback path retains its specified voltage.

title.en: (a): the source sets the divider node to 2 V

text.zh: V_P=0，所以V_N=0。2 V源正端在V₁，故V₁=2 V。在V₁列KCL，流入运放支路电流为零，得到V_O=6 V。
text.en: V_P = 0 implies V_N = 0. The 2 V source is positive at V₁, so V₁ = 2 V. KCL at V₁, with no current into the input branch, gives V_O = 6 V.

title.en: (b): the virtual short sets the divider node

text.zh: 同相端为2 V，故V₁=V_N=2 V。与(a)相同的分压网络给出V_O=6 V。
text.en: The non-inverting input is 2 V, so V₁ = V_N = 2 V. The same divider as in (a) gives V_O = 6 V.

title.en: (c): the feedback resistor has no voltage drop

text.zh: V_N=V_P=0。反相端支路没有其他通路，电流为零，所以20 kΩ上压降为零。2 V源上端比V_N高2 V，因此输出为2 V。
text.en: V_N = V_P = 0. The inverting-input branch has no other current path, so its current is zero and the 20 kΩ resistor has no voltage drop. The upper source terminal is 2 V above V_N, hence the output is 2 V.

title.en: (d): a voltage follower with a feedback resistor

text.zh: V_N=V_P=2 V，反馈电阻电流为零，输出与反相端电位相等，故V_O=2 V。
text.en: V_N = V_P = 2 V. With zero current in the feedback resistor, the output equals the inverting-input potential, giving V_O = 2 V.

pitfalls.zh: 虚短是两个输入端电位相等，不是把串联的2 V源短路。
pitfalls.en: A virtual short equates the input potentials; it does not short the series 2 V source.

pitfalls.zh: (c)(d)反馈电阻电流为零；不能把它们错当作带接地输入电阻的普通放大器。
pitfalls.en: The feedback-resistor current in (c) and (d) is zero; these circuits do not have the grounded input resistor of a conventional gain network.

methods.zh: 逐图检查电压源长线正端和实际反馈连接；独立代回KCL：(a)(b)两电阻电流均为0.2 mA，(c)(d)反馈电流均为0。所有结果同时满足V_N=V_P。未声称与外部参考答案对照。
methods.en: Inspected each source positive terminal and actual feedback connection. Independent substitution into KCL gives 0.2 mA in both divider resistors for (a) and (b), and zero feedback current for (c) and (d). All results satisfy V_N = V_P. No external-answer-key comparison is claimed.

assumptions.zh: 按本章理想运放模型，负反馈且工作在线性区。
assumptions.en: Ideal op-amp model with negative feedback and linear operation, as used in this chapter.

title.zh: 双运放差分输出与输入电阻
title.en: Two-op-amp differential output and input resistance

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题2.3.7所示，v_i=0.5sin ωt V。（1）试求v_o1、v_o2和v_o；（2）求电路的电压增益A_v=v_o/v_i和输入电阻R_i。
statement.en: The circuit is shown in Fig. 2.3.7, with v_i = 0.5 sin(ωt) V. (1) Find v_o1, v_o2 and v_o. (2) Find the voltage gain A_v = v_o/v_i and the input resistance R_i.

alt.zh: 输入v_i同时接A₁同相端前的12 kΩ和A₂反相端前的12 kΩ；A₁反馈40 kΩ、反相端对地12 kΩ；A₂反馈30 kΩ、同相端经12 kΩ接地。输出v_o定义上正下负，即v_o1-v_o2。
alt.en: Input v_i connects through separate 12 kΩ resistors to A₁’s non-inverting input and A₂’s inverting input. A₁ has 40 kΩ feedback and 12 kΩ from its inverting input to ground. A₂ has 30 kΩ feedback and its non-inverting input is grounded through 12 kΩ. Output v_o is positive at v_o1 and negative at v_o2.

prerequisites.zh: 同相、反相放大器；差分电压的参考极性；端口输入电阻。
prerequisites.en: Non-inverting and inverting amplifiers; differential-output polarity; port input resistance.

recognition.zh: 先拆成上方同相放大器与下方反相放大器，分别求输出，再按图示正负端相减。输入电阻要从信号源的总取流量计算。
recognition.en: Treat the upper stage as non-inverting and the lower stage as inverting. Find each output, then subtract according to the marked polarity. Find input resistance from the total current drawn from the signal source.

text.zh: 同相端不取电流，其前面的12 kΩ无压降，故同相端电压就是v_i。A₁增益为1+40/12=13/3。
text.en: The non-inverting input draws no current, so its series 12 kΩ resistor has no voltage drop and its voltage equals v_i. A₁’s gain is 1 + 40/12 = 13/3.

text.zh: A₂同相端为0，反相端为虚地。其增益为-30/12=-5/2。
text.en: A₂’s non-inverting input is at 0 V and its inverting input is a virtual ground. Its gain is -30/12 = -5/2.

title.en: Subtract according to the output polarity

text.zh: 图中v_o上正下负，故v_o=v_o1-v_o2。下方输出本身为负，相减后两项的幅值相加。
text.en: The output is marked positive at the top and negative at the bottom, so v_o = v_o1 - v_o2. Since the lower output is negative, the amplitudes add.

title.en: Find R_i from the total input current

text.zh: 上方同相支路输入电流为零。输入电流全部通过下方12 kΩ流向A₂虚地，所以i_i=v_i/(12 kΩ)。
text.en: The upper non-inverting branch draws zero input current. All input current flows through the lower 12 kΩ resistor into A₂’s virtual ground, so i_i = v_i/(12 kΩ).

answer.en: v_o1 = (13/6) sin(ωt) V, v_o2 = -(5/4) sin(ωt) V, and v_o = (41/12) sin(ωt) V; A_v = 41/6 ≈ 6.833 and R_i = 12 kΩ.

pitfalls.zh: v_o是两个输出端之间的电压，不是某一个运放的对地输出。
pitfalls.en: v_o is the voltage between the two outputs, not either single output relative to ground.

pitfalls.zh: 上方串联12 kΩ不与下方12 kΩ并联取流，因为理想同相输入端的电流为零。
pitfalls.en: The upper series 12 kΩ does not draw current in parallel with the lower 12 kΩ, because the ideal non-inverting input current is zero.

methods.zh: 逐点代回运放反相节点KCL。A₁节点电位v_i满足v_i/12k+(v_i-v_o1)/40k=0；A₂虚地满足-v_i/12k-v_o2/30k=0。输入取流式和输出极性独立核查均一致。
methods.en: Substituted into KCL at each inverting node. A₁’s node at v_i satisfies v_i/12k + (v_i - v_o1)/40k = 0; A₂’s virtual ground satisfies -v_i/12k - v_o2/30k = 0. Input-current and output-polarity checks agree.

assumptions.zh: 按本章理想运放模型，负反馈且工作在线性区。
assumptions.en: Ideal op-amp model with negative feedback and linear operation, as used in this chapter.

title.zh: 增益可调求差电路：两个反相节点列KCL
title.en: Adjustable subtractor: KCL at both inverting nodes

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 增益可调求差电路如图题2.4.5所示，试推导函数关系v_o=f(v_1,v_2)。
statement.en: The adjustable-gain subtractor is shown in Fig. 2.4.5. Derive the relationship v_o = f(v_1, v_2).

alt.zh: A₁同相输入v₁，A₂同相输入v₂。两个反相节点之间跨接R_G。A₁反相节点经R₂接地、经R₁接A₁输出v_o1；A₂反相节点经R₁接v_o1、经R₂接最终输出v_o。
alt.en: A₁’s non-inverting input is v₁ and A₂’s is v₂. R_G bridges their inverting nodes. A₁’s inverting node connects through R₂ to ground and R₁ to v_o1. A₂’s inverting node connects through R₁ to v_o1 and R₂ to the final output v_o.

prerequisites.zh: 理想运放虚短、虚断；节点电流法；代数消元。
prerequisites.en: Ideal op-amp virtual short and zero input currents; nodal KCL; algebraic elimination.

recognition.zh: R_G连接两个反相节点，两个运放相互关联。直接把这两个节点电位分别写成v₁、v₂，再列两条KCL，消去中间输出v_o1。
recognition.en: R_G connects the two inverting nodes, coupling the stages. Set their potentials to v₁ and v₂, write two KCL equations, and eliminate the intermediate output v_o1.

text.zh: 在理想负反馈下，A₁反相节点为v₁，A₂反相节点为v₂。两个输入端均不取电流。
text.en: With ideal negative feedback, A₁’s inverting node is v₁ and A₂’s is v₂. Neither input draws current.

title.en: Apply KCL at A₁’s inverting node

text.zh: 以流出节点为正，把流向地、v_o1和v₂的三条支路电流相加为零，先解出v_o1。
text.en: Taking currents leaving the node as positive, sum the branches to ground, v_o1 and v₂. Solve first for v_o1.

title.en: Apply KCL at A₂’s inverting node

text.zh: 流向v_o1、v_o和v₁的三条支路电流之和为零，把最终输出写成v_o1的函数。
text.en: Sum the currents toward v_o1, v_o and v₁ to zero, then express the final output in terms of v_o1.

text.zh: 代入v_o1并合并v₁、v₂的系数，可见两者系数大小相同、符号相反，输出只与差值v₂-v₁有关。
text.en: Substitute v_o1 and collect the coefficients of v₁ and v₂. They have equal magnitude and opposite signs, so the output depends only on v₂ - v₁.

answer.zh: v_o=[1+R₂/R₁+2R₂/R_G](v₂-v₁)。减小R_G会提高差模增益；此结论以运放保持线性为前提。
answer.en: v_o = [1 + R₂/R₁ + 2R₂/R_G](v₂ - v₁). Decreasing R_G increases the differential gain, provided the op amps remain linear.

pitfalls.zh: R_G中电流为(v₁-v₂)/R_G，不是v₁/R_G；它不接地。
pitfalls.en: The current in R_G is (v₁ - v₂)/R_G, not v₁/R_G; R_G is not grounded.

pitfalls.zh: 输出对应v₂-v₁；若将差分输入定义为v₁-v₂，增益需带负号。
pitfalls.en: The output is proportional to v₂ - v₁; if the differential input is defined as v₁ - v₂, the gain is negative.

methods.zh: 以符号消元核查两条独立节点方程；v₁=v₂时输出为0，R_G趋于无穷时退化为[1+R₂/R₁](v₂-v₁)。另取R₁=10 kΩ、R₂=20 kΩ、R_G=5 kΩ、v₁=0.1 V、v₂=0.2 V，独立解节点方程得v_o1=-0.05 V、v_o=1.1 V，代回两式残差为0。
methods.en: Checked by symbolic elimination of the two independent nodal equations. Equal inputs give zero output, and R_G → ∞ gives [1 + R₂/R₁](v₂ - v₁). With R₁ = 10 kΩ, R₂ = 20 kΩ, R_G = 5 kΩ, v₁ = 0.1 V and v₂ = 0.2 V, an independent nodal solve gives v_o1 = -0.05 V and v_o = 1.1 V, with zero residuals.

assumptions.zh: 按本章理想运放模型，负反馈且工作在线性区。
assumptions.en: Ideal op-amp model with negative feedback and linear operation, as used in this chapter.

title.zh: INA128：先区分共模电压与两端信号极性
title.en: INA128: separate common-mode voltage and signal polarity

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: INA128型仪用放大器电路如图题2.4.9所示，其中R₁是外接电阻。（1）它的输入干扰电压V_C=1 V（直流），输入信号v_i1=v_i2=0.04sin ωt V，当R₁=1 kΩ时，求出v₃、v₄、v₃-v₄和v_o的电压值；（2）当输入信号v_i1=v_i2=0.01sin ωt V，要求v_o=-6sin ωt V，求此时外接电阻R₁的阻值。
statement.en: The INA128 instrumentation amplifier is shown in Fig. 2.4.9, where R₁ is an external resistor. (1) Its input interference voltage is V_C = 1 V DC and its input signals are v_i1 = v_i2 = 0.04 sin(ωt) V. With R₁ = 1 kΩ, find v₃, v₄, v₃ - v₄ and v_o. (2) For v_i1 = v_i2 = 0.01 sin(ωt) V, require v_o = -6 sin(ωt) V. Find the required external resistance R₁.

alt.zh: 共模源V_C=1 V接在两信号源中点：上端v₁=V_C+v_i1，下端v₂=V_C-v_i2。前级两个反相节点之间是外接R₁，每级反馈R₂=25 kΩ。后级匹配差分电路四个电阻均40 kΩ，上端v₃进反相支路、下端v₄进同相支路，故v_o=v₄-v₃。
alt.en: The 1 V common-mode source connects to the midpoint of the signal sources: v₁ = V_C + v_i1 and v₂ = V_C - v_i2. External R₁ bridges the first-stage inverting nodes; each feedback R₂ is 25 kΩ. The final matched difference amplifier uses four 40 kΩ resistors, with v₃ entering its inverting branch and v₄ its non-inverting branch, so v_o = v₄ - v₃.

prerequisites.zh: 共模与差模；仪用放大器前级节点分析；匹配差分放大器。
prerequisites.en: Common-mode and differential-mode signals; first-stage instrumentation-amplifier nodal analysis; matched difference amplifier.

recognition.zh: 必须按图中两信号源的正负端先写v₁、v₂。虽然v_i1=v_i2，上下输入节点并不相等；它们对共模中点的方向相反。先求前级两输出，再作后级相减。
recognition.en: First write v₁ and v₂ from the source polarities. Although v_i1 = v_i2, the two input-node voltages differ because the signals face opposite directions relative to the common-mode midpoint. Find the first-stage outputs, then apply the final subtraction.

title.zh: 从电压源极性写实际输入
title.en: Write actual inputs from source polarities

text.zh: 图中上信号源上正下负，下信号源也上正下负，而V_C接它们的中点。因此v₁=V_C+v_i1，v₂=V_C-v_i2。第（1）问差模输入为0.08sin ωt V。
text.en: Both signal sources have their positive terminal at the top, while V_C connects to their midpoint. Thus v₁ = V_C + v_i1 and v₂ = V_C - v_i2. In part (1), the differential input is 0.08 sin(ωt) V.

steps.formula: v_1=1+0.04\sin\omega t,\quad v_2=1-0.04\sin\omega t,\quad v_1-v_2=0.08\sin\omega t\,\mathrm{V}

title.en: Write the two first-stage node equations

text.zh: 由虚短，反相节点A、B分别等于v₁、v₂。令R₂=25 kΩ，在两节点列KCL，解得v₃、v₄；相减得前级差模增益1+2R₂/R₁。
text.en: The virtual short gives node A = v₁ and node B = v₂. With R₂ = 25 kΩ, KCL gives v₃ and v₄; their difference has gain 1 + 2R₂/R₁.

text.zh: R₂/R₁=25，故前级输出仍包含共同的1 V直流分量，交流分量大小为2.04 V且符号相反。
text.en: R₂/R₁ = 25. Both first-stage outputs retain the same 1 V DC component, while their AC components have opposite signs and amplitude 2.04 V.

steps.formula: v_3=1+2.04\sin\omega t\,\mathrm{V},\quad v_4=1-2.04\sin\omega t\,\mathrm{V},\quad v_3-v_4=4.08\sin\omega t\,\mathrm{V}

title.en: The final subtraction removes common mode

text.zh: 后级电阻比为1。v₃进入反相支路、v₄进入同相支路，所以v_o=v₄-v₃，输出的1 V直流分量消除。
text.en: The final stage has matched resistor ratios of 1. Because v₃ enters the inverting branch and v₄ the non-inverting branch, v_o = v₄ - v₃, cancelling the 1 V DC component.

title.zh: 第（2）问先算所需差模增益
title.en: Part (2): find the required differential gain

text.zh: 两信号源幅值都为0.01 V，实际差模幅值为0.02 V。要得到6 V输出幅值，需要前级差模增益300。由1+50 kΩ/R₁=300解外接电阻。
text.en: Each signal-source amplitude is 0.01 V, so the actual differential amplitude is 0.02 V. A 6 V output amplitude requires differential gain 300. Solve 1 + 50 kΩ/R₁ = 300 for the external resistor.

answer.zh: （1）v₃=1+2.04sin ωt V，v₄=1-2.04sin ωt V，v₃-v₄=4.08sin ωt V，v_o=-4.08sin ωt V。（2）R₁=50 kΩ/299≈167.22 Ω。
answer.en: (1) v₃ = 1 + 2.04 sin(ωt) V, v₄ = 1 - 2.04 sin(ωt) V, v₃ - v₄ = 4.08 sin(ωt) V, and v_o = -4.08 sin(ωt) V. (2) R₁ = 50 kΩ/299 ≈ 167.22 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: v_i1=v_i2不代表v₁=v₂；必须看两个电压源相对中点的极性。
pitfalls.en: v_i1 = v_i2 does not mean v₁ = v₂; inspect each source polarity relative to the midpoint.

pitfalls.zh: 求外接电阻时保留增益公式中的1，不能以50 kΩ/300替代精确结果。
pitfalls.en: Retain the 1 in the gain equation; 50 kΩ/300 is not the exact required resistance.

pitfalls.zh: 题干在第47页，电路在第48页，需合并阅读。
pitfalls.en: The statement is on printed p. 47 and the figure on p. 48; read them together.

methods.zh: 按图中25 kΩ、40 kΩ和源极性重新推导。正弦峰值处，A=1.04 V、B=0.96 V，跨R₁电流80 μA；两25 kΩ压降均2 V，得v₃=3.04 V、v₄=-1.04 V。后级非反相节点v₄/2=-0.52 V，反相节点KCL得v_o=-4.08 V。第二问代回167.2240802676 Ω得差模增益300、输出幅值6 V。
methods.en: Re-derived from the actual 25 kΩ and 40 kΩ resistors and source polarities. At the positive sine peak, A = 1.04 V and B = 0.96 V, giving 80 μA through R₁; each 25 kΩ feedback resistor drops 2 V, so v₃ = 3.04 V and v₄ = -1.04 V. The final non-inverting node is v₄/2 = -0.52 V, and KCL at the inverting node gives v_o = -4.08 V. Substituting 167.2240802676 Ω in part (2) gives gain 300 and output amplitude 6 V.

assumptions.zh: 按本章理想运放模型，负反馈且工作在线性区。
assumptions.en: Ideal op-amp model with negative feedback and linear operation, as used in this chapter.

completionNote.en: Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

title.zh: 由指数模型求反向饱和电流与十倍电流电压
title.en: Use the exponential model for saturation current and a tenfold current increase

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 在室温（300 K）情况下，若二极管加0.7 V正向电压时，产生的正向电流为1 mA。（1）求二极管的反向饱和电流；（2）当二极管正向电流增加10倍时，其电压应为多少？设n=1。
statement.en: At room temperature (300 K), a diode carries 1 mA when a forward voltage of 0.7 V is applied. (1) Find its reverse saturation current. (2) Find its voltage when the forward current increases tenfold. Assume n = 1.

prerequisites.zh: 二极管指数模型；热电压；自然对数。
prerequisites.en: Diode exponential model; thermal voltage; natural logarithms.

recognition.zh: 先用已知工作点反求I_S；换到新电流时使用同一个I_S。电流按倍数变化对应电压按对数增加。
recognition.en: Use the known operating point to recover I_S, then keep that same I_S for the new current. Multiplying the current produces a logarithmic voltage increase.

text.zh: 采用相邻题3.2.1给出的V_T=26 mV，且本题n=1。保留指数模型中的-1。
text.en: Use V_T = 26 mV, given in adjacent exercise 3.2.1, and n = 1. Retain the -1 term in the exponential model.

text.zh: 将0.7 V、1 mA代入指数模型。反向饱和电流是模型参数，不等于当前的正向电流。
text.en: Substitute 0.7 V and 1 mA into the model. Reverse saturation current is a model parameter, not the present forward current.

text.zh: 新电流为10 mA。由指数模型反解电压，得到约0.75987 V。
text.en: The new current is 10 mA. Invert the exponential relation to obtain approximately 0.75987 V.

title.en: Quick check from the voltage increment

text.zh: 因两个正向电流都远大于I_S，可以用ΔV≈V_T ln10复核，电压约增加59.87 mV。
text.en: Both forward currents greatly exceed I_S, so ΔV ≈ V_T ln 10 provides a check: the voltage rises by about 59.87 mV.

answer.en: Using V_T = 26 mV: (1) I_S ≈ 2.03 × 10⁻¹⁵ A. (2) V_D ≈ 0.75987 V, an increase of about 59.87 mV.

pitfalls.zh: 指数函数的电压单位必须一致，0.7/0.026不是0.7/26。
pitfalls.en: Use consistent voltage units in the exponent: 0.7/0.026, not 0.7/26.

pitfalls.zh: 热电压采用26 mV是教材近似；若取kT/q的更精细数值，I_S会有明显差别，因此必须说明参数。
pitfalls.en: The textbook uses the 26 mV approximation. A more precise kT/q changes I_S noticeably, so the chosen thermal voltage must be stated.

methods.zh: 将求得I_S分别代回0.7 V和0.759867 V，独立回算电流为1 mA和10 mA。精确含-1式与强正向近似的差异远小于所报精度。
methods.en: Substituting the recovered I_S at 0.7 V and 0.759867 V independently reproduces 1 mA and 10 mA. The exact -1 formula and strong-forward-bias approximation differ far below the reported precision.

assumptions.zh: 二极管指数模型，n=1；室温热电压按教材相邻题取26 mV。
assumptions.en: Exponential diode model with n = 1; room-temperature thermal voltage is 26 mV as given in the adjacent textbook exercise.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。
completionNote.en: Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

title.zh: 电池充电：先判断导通，再找正负峰值
title.en: Battery charging: check conduction, then examine both source peaks

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 12 V电池的简化充电电路如图题3.4.2所示，用二极管理想模型分析，若v_s是振幅为24 V的正弦波，则二极管流过的峰值电流和二极管两端的最大反向电压各是多少？
statement.en: The simplified charging circuit for a 12 V battery is shown in Fig. 3.4.2. Using the ideal-diode model, find the diode peak current and maximum reverse voltage when v_s is sinusoidal with amplitude 24 V.

alt.zh: 正弦源v_s经100 Ω和向右导通的二极管接12 V电池正端；电池负端与正弦源下端相连。
alt.en: The sinusoidal source connects through 100 Ω and a diode conducting to the right to the positive terminal of a 12 V battery. The battery negative terminal returns to the lower source terminal.

prerequisites.zh: 理想二极管分段模型；KVL；反向电压的定义。
prerequisites.en: Piecewise ideal-diode model; KVL; definition of reverse voltage.

recognition.zh: 电池建立固定12 V门槛。正峰值决定最大充电电流，负峰值决定最大反向电压；二者发生在不同半周。
recognition.en: The battery creates a fixed 12 V threshold. The positive source peak sets the largest charging current; the negative peak sets the largest reverse voltage.

text.zh: 二极管截止时100 Ω中无电流，阳极电位为v_s，阴极电位为12 V。只有v_s>12 V才导通。
text.en: When the diode is off, no current flows through 100 Ω, so its anode is at v_s and cathode at 12 V. It turns on only when v_s > 12 V.

title.en: Use the positive peak for peak current

text.zh: 当v_s=24 V时，理想二极管压降为零，电阻上电压为24-12=12 V。
text.en: At v_s = 24 V, the ideal diode has zero drop and the resistor voltage is 24 - 12 = 12 V.

title.zh: 负峰值求最大反向电压
title.en: Use the negative peak for maximum reverse voltage

text.zh: 当v_s=-24 V时二极管截止，电阻压降为零。最大反向电压为阴极减阳极，即12-(-24)。
text.en: At v_s = -24 V the diode is off and the resistor drop is zero. Reverse voltage is cathode minus anode: 12 - (-24).

answer.zh: 峰值电流120 mA；最大反向电压36 V。
answer.en: Peak current: 120 mA. Maximum reverse voltage: 36 V.

pitfalls.zh: 正弦源振幅是24 V，不是有效值；不再乘√2。
pitfalls.en: 24 V is the sinusoidal amplitude, not RMS; do not multiply it by √2.

pitfalls.zh: 反向峰值要叠加电池电压，不能只取24 V。
pitfalls.en: The reverse peak includes the battery voltage; it is not just 24 V.

methods.zh: 逐半周检查理想二极管互补条件：导通时v_AK=0且i_D≥0；截止时i_D=0且v_AK=v_s-12≤0。正峰值KVL为24=12+100×0.12；负峰值反向36 V。
methods.en: Checked ideal-diode complementarity in both half-cycles: on means v_AK = 0 and i_D ≥ 0; off means i_D = 0 and v_AK = v_s - 12 ≤ 0. Positive-peak KVL is 24 = 12 + 100(0.12); the negative peak gives 36 V reverse bias.

assumptions.zh: 理想二极管；理想12 V电池。
assumptions.en: Ideal diode and ideal 12 V battery.

title.zh: 桥式整流：导通路径与二极管耐压
title.en: Bridge rectification: current paths and reverse-voltage rating

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题3.4.3所示，电源v_s为正弦波电压。（1）二极管采用理想模型，试绘出负载R_L两端的电压波形；（2）若v_s的有效值为220 V，则二极管的最高反向工作电压值应为多少？
statement.en: The circuit in Fig. 3.4.3 has a sinusoidal source v_s. (1) Using ideal diodes, draw the voltage waveform across R_L. (2) If v_s has RMS value 220 V, what maximum reverse-working-voltage rating is required for each diode?

alt.zh: 桥式整流器：上左D₁、上右D₂、下右D₃、下左D₄；交流源接桥的上下顶点，负载接左右顶点，右端为输出正端。
alt.en: Bridge rectifier: D₁ upper left, D₂ upper right, D₃ lower right, D₄ lower left. The AC source connects to the top and bottom bridge vertices; the load is between left and right vertices, with output positive at the right.

prerequisites.zh: 二极管导通路径；理想全波整流；正弦有效值与峰值。
prerequisites.en: Diode conduction paths; ideal full-wave rectification; sinusoidal RMS and peak values.

recognition.zh: 分别沿正半周和负半周画闭合电流路径，确认负载电流方向始终相同，再检查每只截止管两端的节点电位。
recognition.en: Trace a closed current path in each half-cycle. The load current keeps the same direction. Then inspect the two node potentials across each off diode.

title.en: Positive half-cycle: D₂ and D₄ conduct

text.zh: v_s>0时，电流从源上端经D₂到负载正端，通过R_L后经D₄回源下端，故v_L=v_s。D₁、D₃反偏。
text.en: For v_s > 0, current flows from the source upper terminal through D₂, through R_L from its positive terminal, then through D₄ back to the source lower terminal. Thus v_L = v_s; D₁ and D₃ are reverse-biased.

title.en: Negative half-cycle: D₃ and D₁ conduct

text.zh: v_s<0时，源下端较高，电流经D₃、R_L、D₁回源上端。负载方向不变，故v_L=-v_s。
text.en: For v_s < 0, the source lower terminal is higher. Current returns through D₃, R_L and D₁ to the upper terminal. Load direction is unchanged, so v_L = -v_s.

text.zh: 把正弦负半周翻到零线上方，峰值保持V_m，周期变为输入的一半，输出脉动频率为输入的两倍。
text.en: Reflect the negative sine half-cycle above zero. The peak remains V_m, the output period is half the input period, and the ripple frequency doubles.

title.zh: 第（2）问：检查截止管反向峰值
title.en: Part (2): check the off-diode reverse peak

text.zh: 以正半周的D₁为例，其阳极在源下端电位、阴极在源上端电位，反向电压为v_s。其他管对称。因此每管PIV为源峰值，而不是两倍源峰值。
text.en: For D₁ in the positive half-cycle, the anode is at the source lower-terminal potential and cathode at the upper-terminal potential, so its reverse voltage is v_s. Symmetry applies to the others. Each diode’s PIV equals the source peak, not twice it.

answer.zh: （1）v_L=|v_s|=V_m|sin ωt|，为全波整流波形；（2）每只管的最大反向电压约311 V，反向工作电压额定值须不低于该值。
answer.en: (1) v_L = |v_s| = V_m |sin(ωt)|, a full-wave rectified waveform. (2) Each diode sees about 311 V maximum reverse voltage; its reverse-working-voltage rating must be at least this value.

pitfalls.zh: 桥式整流每只管的反向峰值为V_m；不要套用中心抽头全波电路的2V_m。
pitfalls.en: A bridge diode sees peak reverse voltage V_m; do not substitute the 2V_m result for a center-tapped full-wave circuit.

pitfalls.zh: 本题为理想管，不扣除两只实际硅管的导通压降。
pitfalls.en: The diodes are ideal here; do not subtract the drops of two real silicon diodes.

methods.zh: 按实际图上四管方向分别追踪两种导通对，并以负载电阻电流i_L=v_L/R_L≥0复核。正半周截止D₁、D₃的v_AK=-v_s≤0，负半周截止D₂、D₄的v_AK=v_s≤0，全部满足模型条件。
methods.en: Traced both conducting pairs using the actual diode directions. The resistor current i_L = v_L/R_L is nonnegative. In the positive half-cycle, off diodes D₁ and D₃ have v_AK = -v_s ≤ 0; in the negative half-cycle, off diodes D₂ and D₄ have v_AK = v_s ≤ 0. Every ideal-model condition is satisfied.

assumptions.zh: 理想二极管；负载为电阻，无滤波电容。
assumptions.en: Ideal diodes with a resistive load and no filter capacitor.

alt.zh: 理想桥式整流波形：灰色虚线为输入正弦，蓝绿色实线为负载输出。负半周翻到零线上方，输出峰值为V_m，输出频率为输入的两倍。
alt.en: Ideal bridge-rectifier waveform. Dashed gray is the sinusoidal input; solid teal is the load output. Negative half-cycles are reflected above zero, with peak V_m and twice the input frequency.

title.zh: 理想二极管状态：先读电池极性，再试断路
title.en: Ideal-diode states: read battery polarities, then test an open diode

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 二极管电路如图题3.4.12所示，试判断图中的二极管是导通还是截止，并求出AO两端电压V_AO。设二极管是理想的。
statement.en: For the diode circuits in Fig. 3.4.12, determine whether each diode is on or off and find the voltage V_AO across terminals A and O. Assume ideal diodes.

alt.zh: 四个电路都含A到固定电位的3 kΩ电阻，O为参考点。(a)D阳极-6 V、下拉电位-12 V；(b)D阳极-15 V、下拉-12 V；(c)两个阳极分别0 V、-15 V，阴极同接A，下拉-12 V；(d)两个阴极分别0 V、-6 V，阳极同接A，电阻另一端+12 V。电池长线为正端。
alt.en: All four circuits have a 3 kΩ resistor from A to a fixed potential, with O as reference. (a) Anode -6 V, pull node -12 V. (b) Anode -15 V, pull node -12 V. (c) Anodes 0 V and -15 V share cathode A, with pull node -12 V. (d) Cathodes 0 V and -6 V share anode A, with resistor pull node +12 V. A battery’s longer plate is positive.

prerequisites.zh: 电池极性与节点电位；理想二极管开关模型；欧姆定律。
prerequisites.en: Battery polarity and node potentials; ideal-diode switching model; Ohm’s law.

recognition.zh: 先把电池上端写成相对O的带符号电位，再假设管截止。若出现阳极高于阴极，则改为导通；最后确认导通电流不为负、截止管不正偏。
recognition.en: Write the signed battery-terminal potentials relative to O. Start with the diode off; if its anode is above its cathode, turn it on. Finally check nonnegative on-current and nonpositive anode-to-cathode voltage for off diodes.

text.zh: 若截止，A=-12 V，阳极-6 V高于阴极，矛盾。因此D导通，A被钳位为-6 V；电阻电流2 mA从A流向-12 V。
text.en: If D were off, A = -12 V, below its -6 V anode, which contradicts the off assumption. D therefore conducts and clamps A to -6 V. The resistor carries 2 mA from A toward -12 V.

text.zh: 截止时A=-12 V，阳极-15 V比阴极低3 V，反偏成立。电阻无电流，A保持-12 V。
text.en: With D off, A = -12 V and the -15 V anode is 3 V below its cathode. The diode is reverse-biased, no resistor current flows, and A remains -12 V.

title.en: (c): D₁ is on and D₂ is off

text.zh: A由3 kΩ向-12 V下拉。阳极在0 V的D₁先导通，将A钳位到0 V；D₂阳极-15 V，因而反偏。D₁向电阻提供4 mA。
text.en: The resistor pulls A toward -12 V. D₁, whose anode is at 0 V, conducts and clamps A to 0 V. D₂’s anode is at -15 V, so D₂ is reverse-biased. D₁ supplies 4 mA to the resistor.

title.en: (d): D₂ is on and D₁ is off

text.zh: 本图12 V电池长线在上，电阻将A向+12 V拉高。两个管共阳极，阴极更低的D₂（-6 V）导通，将A钳位为-6 V。D₁阴极0 V，比阳极高6 V而截止。
text.en: The 12 V battery has its longer plate on top, so the resistor pulls A toward +12 V. With common anodes, D₂’s lower cathode potential (-6 V) makes D₂ conduct and clamp A to -6 V. D₁’s 0 V cathode is 6 V above its anode, so D₁ is off.

answer.zh: (a)D导通，V_AO=-6 V；(b)D截止，V_AO=-12 V；(c)D₁导通、D₂截止，V_AO=0 V；(d)D₁截止、D₂导通，V_AO=-6 V。
answer.en: (a) D on, V_AO = -6 V. (b) D off, V_AO = -12 V. (c) D₁ on and D₂ off, V_AO = 0 V. (d) D₁ off and D₂ on, V_AO = -6 V.

pitfalls.zh: 不能按电池旁“6 V、12 V”字样直接把上端写成正电位，要看长短线。
pitfalls.en: Do not assume a battery upper terminal is positive from its 6 V or 12 V label; inspect the plate lengths.

pitfalls.zh: 两管共同接输出时，必须同时检查另一只管的反偏条件。
pitfalls.en: When two diodes share the output, also check that the other diode remains reverse-biased.

methods.zh: 对所有四图逐项检查互补条件。导通管电流分别为2、4、6 mA，均沿阳极到阴极且为正；截止管v_AK分别为(b)-3 V、(c)D₂的-15 V、(d)D₁的-6 V。各电阻欧姆定律和节点KCL同时成立。
methods.en: Checked complementarity for all four circuits. On-currents are 2, 4 and 6 mA, positive from anode to cathode. Off-diode v_AK values are -3 V in (b), -15 V for D₂ in (c), and -6 V for D₁ in (d). Resistor Ohm’s law and nodal KCL both hold.

assumptions.zh: 理想二极管；按原图电池极性确定各节点。
assumptions.en: Ideal diodes with battery polarities read from the original figure.

title.zh: 浮动电源分压网络：用开路电位判二极管状态
title.en: Floating-source divider: determine diode state from open-circuit potentials

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 试判断图题3.4.13中二极管是导通还是截止，为什么？设二极管是理想的。
statement.en: Determine whether the diode in each circuit of Fig. 3.4.13 is on or off, and explain why. Assume ideal diodes.

alt.zh: 三图D的阳极在右侧A、阴极在左侧B。右分压为15 V经140 kΩ和10 kΩ到地。左主分压为15 V经25 kΩ和5 kΩ到地，记其节点为C。(a)(b)10 V源接18 kΩ、2 kΩ串联，底端接C，B在两电阻之间；两图电源极性相反。(c)20 V源上正下负，C在18 kΩ和2 kΩ之间，B在源下端。
alt.en: In all three figures, D has anode A on the right and cathode B on the left. The right divider is 140 kΩ and 10 kΩ from 15 V to ground. The left main divider is 25 kΩ and 5 kΩ; call its midpoint C. In (a) and (b), a floating 10 V source drives series 18 kΩ and 2 kΩ, with its lower terminal tied to C and B between the resistors; the source polarity reverses between figures. In (c), the 20 V source is positive on top, C lies between 18 kΩ and 2 kΩ, and B is the source lower terminal.

prerequisites.zh: 浮动电压源；电阻分压；理想二极管；戴维南等效与节点分析。
prerequisites.en: Floating voltage sources; resistor division; ideal diodes; Thévenin equivalents and nodal analysis.

recognition.zh: 先把二极管断开，比较A、B的开路电位。独立的浮动电源回路只经一个节点接主网络时，不向该节点净取流，不能把它当作对地分压器。
recognition.en: First open the diode and compare A and B potentials. A floating source loop connected to the main network at only one node draws zero net current from that node; do not treat it as a divider to ground.

title.en: Find the two main divider potentials

text.en: With D open, A = 15(10)/(140 + 10) = 1 V. The 25 kΩ/5 kΩ main divider gives C = 15(5)/(25 + 5) = 2.5 V.

title.en: (a): B is above A, so D is off

text.zh: 10 V源上正下负，2 kΩ上的分压为+1 V，故B=C+1=3.5 V。D阳极A=1 V、阴极B=3.5 V，反偏2.5 V。
text.en: The 10 V source is positive on top; the 2 kΩ divider drop is +1 V, so B = C + 1 = 3.5 V. With anode A = 1 V and cathode B = 3.5 V, D is reverse-biased by 2.5 V.

title.en: (b): reversing the source still leaves D off

text.zh: 10 V源反向，故B=C-1=1.5 V。A仍为1 V，阳极仍低于阴极0.5 V，因此截止。
text.en: Reversing the 10 V source gives B = C - 1 = 1.5 V. A remains 1 V, still 0.5 V below the cathode, so D is off.

title.zh: (c)：开路试算出现正偏，必须导通
title.en: (c): the open-circuit test gives forward bias

text.zh: 20 V源使C比B高20×2/(18+2)=2 V，故开路B=2.5-2=0.5 V。A=1 V高于B，截止假设矛盾，D应导通。导通后节点会相互加载，不能继续把A固定为1 V、B固定为0.5 V。
text.en: The 20 V source puts C 20(2)/(18 + 2) = 2 V above B, giving open-circuit B = 2.5 - 2 = 0.5 V. A = 1 V is above B, contradicting the off assumption; D must conduct. Once on, the dividers load each other, so A and B no longer retain their open-circuit values.

title.zh: 独立检查(c)导通电流方向

text.zh: 将两侧从A、B看入作戴维南等效。右侧电阻140 kΩ∥10 kΩ=28/3 kΩ；左侧电阻(25 kΩ∥5 kΩ)+(18 kΩ∥2 kΩ)=179/30 kΩ。短接A、B后电流从A到B为32.68 μA，正向成立。
text.en: Find the Thévenin resistance seen from each side. On the right, 140 kΩ ∥ 10 kΩ = 28/3 kΩ. On the left, (25 kΩ ∥ 5 kΩ) + (18 kΩ ∥ 2 kΩ) = 179/30 kΩ. Shorting A to B produces 32.68 μA from A to B, confirming forward conduction.

answer.zh: (a)截止：V_A=1 V、V_B=3.5 V；(b)截止：V_A=1 V、V_B=1.5 V；(c)导通：开路试算V_A=1 V>V_B=0.5 V，实际导通电流约32.68 μA（A→B）。
answer.en: (a) Off: V_A = 1 V and V_B = 3.5 V. (b) Off: V_A = 1 V and V_B = 1.5 V. (c) On: the open-circuit test gives V_A = 1 V > V_B = 0.5 V; the actual forward current is about 32.68 μA from A to B.

pitfalls.zh: D的阴极横线在左，阳极A在右；方向看反会把三图结论全部颠倒。
pitfalls.en: The cathode bar is on the left and anode A on the right; reversing this interpretation reverses every conclusion.

pitfalls.zh: 图(c)导通后的电位不能沿用开路试算值。
pitfalls.en: In (c), do not keep the open-circuit node voltages after D turns on.

methods.zh: (a)(b)使用含浮动电源的修正节点方程独立求解，结果分别A=1、B=3.5和A=1、B=1.5 V。(c)通过节点方程与戴维南法两种方法得到同一ID=1/30600 A、A=B=319/459 V、C=1210/459 V，二极管正向电流为正。
methods.en: Independently solved modified nodal equations including the floating source for (a) and (b), obtaining A = 1, B = 3.5 V and A = 1, B = 1.5 V. For (c), nodal and Thévenin methods both give I_D = 1/30600 A, A = B = 319/459 V and C = 1210/459 V, with positive forward diode current.

assumptions.zh: 理想二极管；15 V电源和浮动电源均理想。
assumptions.en: Ideal diode, ideal 15 V supply and ideal floating sources.

title.zh: 带直流偏置的二极管：先静态，后小信号
title.en: Biased diode: solve DC first, then the small signal

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题3.4.14所示，D为硅二极管，V_DD=2 V，R=1 kΩ，正弦信号v_s=50sin(2π×50t) mV。（1）静态（即v_s=0）时，求二极管中的静态电流和v_o的静态电压；（2）动态时，求二极管中的交流电流振幅和v_o的交流电压振幅；（3）求输出电压v_o的总量。
statement.en: In Fig. 3.4.14, D is a silicon diode, V_DD = 2 V, R = 1 kΩ, and v_s = 50 sin(2π × 50t) mV. (1) With v_s = 0, find the diode DC current and the DC output voltage. (2) Find the AC current amplitude through the diode and the AC output-voltage amplitude. (3) Find the total output voltage v_o.

alt.zh: 2 V直流源与v_s同向串联，驱动向右导通的二极管及1 kΩ接地电阻。v_o上正下负，测的是电阻两端电压。
alt.en: The 2 V DC source and v_s are connected in series with matching polarity, driving a diode conducting to the right and a 1 kΩ resistor to ground. Output v_o is measured across the resistor, positive at the top.

prerequisites.zh: 静态工作点；二极管恒压降模型和小信号电阻；直流与交流叠加。
prerequisites.en: DC operating point; constant-drop and small-signal diode models; DC-plus-AC superposition.

recognition.zh: 先用0.7 V硅管近似求Q点，再以r_d=V_T/I_DQ代替交流二极管。输出跨电阻，交流分压应取R/(R+r_d)。
recognition.en: First find the Q point with the 0.7 V silicon approximation, then replace the diode by r_d = V_T/I_DQ for AC. Because the output is across R, the AC divider factor is R/(R + r_d).

text.zh: 采用硅二极管正向压降约0.7 V，静态时电阻分得2-0.7=1.3 V，串联电流为1.3 mA。
text.en: Using a silicon forward drop of approximately 0.7 V, the resistor DC voltage is 2 - 0.7 = 1.3 V and the series current is 1.3 mA.

text.zh: 采用本章室温V_T=26 mV、n=1，得r_d=26 mV/1.3 mA=20 Ω。交流等效中独立直流电压源短路，输入驱动r_d与R串联。
text.en: Using the chapter’s room-temperature V_T = 26 mV and n = 1 gives r_d = 26 mV/1.3 mA = 20 Ω. In the AC equivalent, the independent DC voltage source is shorted and the signal drives r_d in series with R.

text.zh: 输入峰值50 mV，故交流电流峰值为50 mV/(1000+20) Ω，输出峰值为其乘1 kΩ。
text.en: The input peak is 50 mV, so the AC current amplitude is 50 mV/(1000 + 20) Ω. Multiply by 1 kΩ for the output amplitude.

text.zh: 交流电流与输入同相，输出也同相。把1.3 V静态值与约49.02 mV的50 Hz正弦量相加。
text.en: The AC current and output are in phase with the input. Add the 1.3 V DC value to the approximately 49.02 mV, 50 Hz sinusoidal component.

title.zh: 检查小信号和持续导通条件
title.en: Check small-signal validity and continuous conduction

text.zh: 二极管上的交流峰值仅r_d I_m≈0.9804 mV，远小于26 mV；最小总电流约1.3-0.04902=1.25098 mA>0，二极管整个周期都保持正向导通。
text.en: The diode AC-voltage amplitude is only r_d I_m ≈ 0.9804 mV, much smaller than 26 mV. Minimum total current is about 1.3 - 0.04902 = 1.25098 mA > 0, so the diode remains forward-conducting throughout the cycle.

answer.zh: 按V_DQ≈0.7 V、V_T=26 mV、n=1：（1）I_DQ≈1.3 mA，V_OQ≈1.3 V；（2）I_m≈49.02 μA，V_om≈49.02 mV；（3）v_o≈1.3+0.04902sin(100πt) V。以上交流结果为一阶小信号近似。
answer.en: Using V_DQ ≈ 0.7 V, V_T = 26 mV and n = 1: (1) I_DQ ≈ 1.3 mA and V_OQ ≈ 1.3 V. (2) I_m ≈ 49.02 μA and V_om ≈ 49.02 mV. (3) v_o ≈ 1.3 + 0.04902 sin(100πt) V. AC results are first-order small-signal approximations.

pitfalls.zh: v_o跨1 kΩ电阻，不是跨二极管；两者交流振幅分别约49.02 mV和0.9804 mV。
pitfalls.en: v_o is across the 1 kΩ resistor, not the diode. Their AC amplitudes are approximately 49.02 mV and 0.9804 mV, respectively.

pitfalls.zh: 不能把直流压降0.7 V模型原封不动用于交流，否则无法给出本题的小信号电阻影响。
pitfalls.en: Do not use the fixed 0.7 V drop unchanged for AC; it omits the small-signal resistance requested here.

methods.zh: 交流KVL独立核对：(R+r_d)I_m=50 mV，R I_m+r_d I_m=49.0196+0.9804=50 mV。以Q点校准指数模型，数值解正负输入峰值的非线性串联方程，确认输出与一阶近似的误差小于0.020 mV，且始终正向导通。
methods.en: Independent AC KVL gives (R + r_d)I_m = 50 mV, with R I_m + r_d I_m = 49.0196 + 0.9804 = 50 mV. Calibrating an exponential model at the Q point and solving the nonlinear series equation at both input peaks confirms an output error below 0.020 mV from the first-order approximation and continuous forward conduction.

assumptions.zh: 静态采用硅管0.7 V近似；交流采用n=1、室温V_T=26 mV的小信号模型。题目没有给出器件I_S，不能把近似结果宣称为某实际器件的精确指数解。
assumptions.en: DC uses the 0.7 V silicon approximation; AC uses n = 1 and room-temperature V_T = 26 mV. The exercise does not specify device I_S, so these approximate results are not claimed as an exact exponential solution for a particular real device.

results.model: constant-drop DC plus first-order exponential small-signal model

completionNote.en: Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

title.zh: 从转移曲线判断MOS类型及阈值
title.en: Read MOS type and threshold from transfer curves

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 图题4.1.1所示为MOS管的转移特性，请分别说明各属于何种类型的MOS管。指出它们的阈值电压各为多少？（图中i_D的参考方向为流进漏极。）
statement.en: Fig. 4.1.1 shows MOS transfer characteristics. Identify the type of MOSFET represented by each curve and state its threshold voltage. The reference direction of i_D is into the drain.

alt.zh: 三条i_D-v_GS曲线：(a)i_D为正，零电流交点v_GS=-3 V且v_GS=0时仍有正电流；(b)i_D为负，零电流交点+2 V且v_GS=0时有负电流；(c)i_D为负，在v_GS=-4 V进入导通，v_GS=0时截止。
alt.en: Three i_D versus v_GS curves: (a) positive i_D, zero-current threshold at -3 V and nonzero current at v_GS = 0; (b) negative i_D, threshold at +2 V and nonzero current at zero gate voltage; (c) negative i_D, onset at -4 V and off at zero gate voltage.

prerequisites.zh: NMOS/PMOS电流方向；增强型/耗尽型定义；阈值电压的带符号值。
prerequisites.en: NMOS/PMOS current directions; enhancement/depletion definitions; signed threshold voltage.

recognition.zh: 先用漏极电流符号识别N/P沟道，再看v_GS=0是否已导通识别增强/耗尽，最后读曲线与横轴的阈值交点。
recognition.en: Use the drain-current sign to identify N/P channel, then inspect conduction at v_GS = 0 to distinguish enhancement/depletion, and finally read the threshold at the zero-current intercept.

title.en: (a): positive drain current and conduction at zero gate voltage

text.zh: 电流参考方向流进漏极，正i_D对应NMOS。v_GS=0时已有电流，故为耗尽型，阈值读为-3 V。
text.en: With i_D referenced into the drain, positive current indicates NMOS. Nonzero current at v_GS = 0 identifies depletion mode, with threshold -3 V.

title.en: (b): negative drain current and conduction at zero gate voltage

text.zh: 负i_D表示实际电流流出漏极，对应PMOS。零栅压仍导通，故为耗尽型；正向栅压增至+2 V才截止，阈值+2 V。
text.en: Negative i_D means current leaves the drain, identifying PMOS. Conduction at zero gate voltage indicates depletion mode; a positive gate voltage of +2 V is needed to cut it off, so the threshold is +2 V.

title.zh: (c)：负漏极电流且需负栅压开启
title.en: (c): negative drain current requiring negative gate voltage

text.zh: 负i_D对应PMOS。v_GS=0时截止，只有栅压低于-4 V才导通，因此为增强型PMOS，阈值-4 V。
text.en: Negative i_D identifies PMOS. It is off at v_GS = 0 and turns on only when v_GS falls below -4 V, so it is an enhancement-mode PMOS with threshold -4 V.

answer.zh: (a)耗尽型NMOS，V_TN=-3 V；(b)耗尽型PMOS，V_TP=+2 V；(c)增强型PMOS，V_TP=-4 V。
answer.en: (a) Depletion-mode NMOS, V_TN = -3 V. (b) Depletion-mode PMOS, V_TP = +2 V. (c) Enhancement-mode PMOS, V_TP = -4 V.

pitfalls.zh: PMOS阈值不能一概写成负值，耗尽型PMOS阈值可为正。
pitfalls.en: A PMOS threshold is not always negative; depletion-mode PMOS can have a positive threshold.

pitfalls.zh: 阈值读取电流刚消失的横轴交点，不读取纵轴电流截距。
pitfalls.en: Read the threshold from the zero-current gate-voltage intercept, not the drain-current-axis intercept.

methods.zh: 按三项独立特征复核：电流符号确定沟道类型，零栅压是否导通确定增强/耗尽，曲线开始导通方向与阈值符号满足NMOS v_GS>V_TN、PMOS v_GS<V_TP。三图均一致。
methods.en: Cross-checked three independent features: current sign identifies channel type, zero-gate conduction identifies enhancement/depletion, and the onset direction agrees with NMOS v_GS > V_TN or PMOS v_GS < V_TP. All three curves are consistent.

assumptions.zh: 按图中i_D流入漏极的参考方向；以理想转移曲线读取阈值。
assumptions.en: Drain-current reference is into the drain, as stated; thresholds are read from the ideal transfer curves.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。
completionNote.en: Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

title.zh: 由迁移率、氧化层电容及宽长比求NMOS电流
title.en: Find NMOS current from mobility, oxide capacitance and aspect ratio

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 设增强型NMOS管的参数为V_TN=1 V，W=100 μm，L=5 μm，μ_n=650 cm²/(V·s)，C_ox=76.7×10⁻⁹ F/cm²。已知V_GS=2V_TN时，MOS管工作在恒流区，试计算此时的电流I_D。
statement.en: An enhancement-mode NMOS has V_TN = 1 V, W = 100 μm, L = 5 μm, μ_n = 650 cm²/(V·s), and C_ox = 76.7 × 10⁻⁹ F/cm². At V_GS = 2V_TN it operates in saturation. Calculate I_D.

prerequisites.zh: MOS饱和区平方律；过驱动电压；单位一致性。
prerequisites.en: MOS saturation square law; overdrive voltage; consistent units.

recognition.zh: 先算过驱动V_GS-V_TN和几何比W/L，再把迁移率与单位面积电容相乘。直接使用完整平方律，避免不同K定义造成漏掉1/2。
recognition.en: First find overdrive V_GS - V_TN and aspect ratio W/L, then multiply mobility by capacitance per unit area. Use the complete square-law expression to avoid losing the factor 1/2 under differing K conventions.

text.zh: V_GS=2V_TN=2 V，故过驱动为1 V；W、L同用μm，因此比值为20。
text.en: V_GS = 2V_TN = 2 V, giving overdrive 1 V. W and L are both in μm, so their ratio is 20.

text.zh: 忽略沟道长度调制，恒流区电流为(1/2)μ_n C_ox(W/L)V_OV²。μ_n中的cm²与C_ox中的cm⁻²互消。
text.en: Neglecting channel-length modulation, saturation current is (1/2)μ_n C_ox(W/L)V_OV². The cm² in mobility cancels the cm⁻² in oxide capacitance.
Substituting 650, 76.7 × 10⁻⁹, 20 and 1² gives 4.9855 × 10⁻⁴ A, approximately 0.499 mA.

text.zh: 题目已经说明处于恒流区，该假设要求V_DS≥V_GS-V_TN=1 V。题目未给V_DS，因此只能列出这一必要条件，不能编造具体漏源电压。
text.en: The exercise states saturation operation, which requires V_DS ≥ V_GS - V_TN = 1 V. No V_DS is supplied, so this condition can be stated but a particular drain-source voltage cannot be invented.

answer.zh: 忽略沟道长度调制，I_D=0.49855 mA≈0.499 mA（约0.50 mA）；题设恒流区要求V_DS≥1 V。
answer.en: Neglecting channel-length modulation, I_D = 0.49855 mA ≈ 0.499 mA (about 0.50 mA). The stated saturation region requires V_DS ≥ 1 V.

pitfalls.zh: 式中已有1/2，不要因另定义K而再乘或再除一次2。
pitfalls.en: The full equation already contains 1/2; do not multiply or divide by 2 again when introducing K.

pitfalls.zh: 原题C_ox为76.7×10⁻⁹ F/cm²，不能误读成10⁻⁸。
pitfalls.en: The original C_ox is 76.7 × 10⁻⁹ F/cm², not 10⁻⁸.

methods.zh: 第二次独立使用SI单位：μ_n=0.065 m²/(V·s)，C_ox=7.67×10⁻⁴ F/m²，代入同一物理模型得到0.00049855 A，与cm单位计算一致；并检查过驱动1 V为正。
methods.en: Independent SI-unit check: μ_n = 0.065 m²/(V·s) and C_ox = 7.67 × 10⁻⁴ F/m². Substitution gives 0.00049855 A, matching the cm-unit calculation; the overdrive is also positive at 1 V.

assumptions.zh: 理想长沟道MOS平方律，忽略沟道长度调制；按题设处于恒流区。
assumptions.en: Ideal long-channel MOS square law, neglecting channel-length modulation, with saturation operation as stated.
